en.headline: UK exempts Hong Kong BN(O) visa holders from proposed 10-year settlement wait
en.dek: British Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood confirmed BN(O) applicants keep their five-year path to settlement but face stricter English-language and criminality requirements.
body: Hongkongers who hold British National (Overseas) visas will be exempt from plans to lengthen the standard qualifying period for settlement in the United Kingdom to 10 years, according to an official announcement.

British Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood outlined the immigration overhaul in a statement to the House of Commons. Under the new framework most migrants will no longer qualify for indefinite leave to remain almost automatically after five years. BN(O) visa holders retain their existing five-year continuous residence route, together with the requirement to pass the Life in the UK test.

They will still be subject to stricter English-language and criminality requirements that form part of the broader changes. The South China Morning Post reported the details from the official announcement published on Monday evening.

The BN(O) route, introduced in 2021, allows eligible Hong Kong residents and certain family members to live, work and study in the UK for five years before applying for settlement and subsequently citizenship. The exemption confirms earlier commitments that the pathway for this group would not be lengthened under the earned-settlement reforms.

zh.headline: 英國豁免BNO簽證持有人 不受擬議十年定居期影響
zh.dek: 內政大臣沙巴娜·馬哈茂德確認BNO申請人維持五年定居途徑，但仍須符合更嚴格的英語及品行要求。
body: 持有英國國民（海外）簽證的香港人將獲豁免，不受英國擬將定居資格期延長至十年的計劃影響。
英國內政大臣沙巴娜·馬哈茂德在下議院發表聲明，概述移民制度改革。根據新框架，大多數移民將不再幾乎自動在五年後獲得無限期居留權。BNO簽證持有人維持現有的五年連續居留途徑，並須通過「生活在英國」測試。
他們仍須符合更嚴格的英語水平及無犯罪紀錄要求，這些是更廣泛改革的一部分。《南華早報》引述周一晚官方公布的詳情報道。
BNO途徑於2021年推出，讓合資格的香港居民及若干家庭成員在英國生活、工作及學習五年後可申請定居，其後可申請入籍。是次豁免確認早前承諾，此群體的途徑不會因「賺取定居」改革而延長。
